claude_v08_review.issue: Doorway POV into small dim room with beds, table, one window, no people; reads a bit cosier than 'cramped' but acceptable.
Bird's-eye table, bread and bowls, four children's hands, patched sleeve visible, empty tabletop upper right.
Mother's reddened hands wringing laundry over washtub, steam, calm upper right.
High-angle detail of hands laying straw mattress and blankets by tiled stove, oil lamp glow; differs from wide P04-02.
Mother mending by kerosene lamp, sleeping children as dim shapes, dark upper right. Angle closer to eye level than low, acceptable.
Seated POV along table to empty chair, a few siblings' hands, no faces, amber side light.
Lane with wooden houses, small mother and boy hand in hand, clear sky upper right. More wide than extreme-wide and only slightly high, acceptable.
Rabbi teaching boys on a bench, plain wall upper right. Camera is near adult eye level rather than low, and boys look 6-8 rather than 4-6; minor.
Examiner in long coat and hat before a row of boys at a table, plain wall upper right, Yitzhak not singled out.
High wide shot, boy by tiled stove looking up at mother seen half from behind, calm wall above his head for balloon.
Extreme-wide high view of empty cheder benches, tiny Yitzhak in background, cool grey light.
Bird's-eye bed, boy about seven with both feet bandaged, shoes on floor, bag by door, open floor upper right.
Blue dusk town, one yellow window with small silhouette of the boy, lots of sky upper right. Silhouette reads as at a table more than on a bed; minor.
POV from bed with bandaged feet, hand in doorway holding crumpled newspapers, plain wall upper right.
Boy reading in bed lit by the page, dark upper area. Looks closer to 10 than 8 and angle is near eye level; acceptable.
Child's finger under a blank line in a column of illegible grey print, lamp, calm upper area.
Empty carved wooden balcony with misty vignette, no border, no people.
Over father's shoulder on Yitzhak about 11 in bed, calm wall above his head.
Father with raised finger and newspaper by lamp, space above head. Angle near eye level rather than low; minor.
Over Yitzhak's shoulder onto mother listening softly; he is not very blurred but reads as foreground.
Rough opening in wall joining a bright second room, no people, bright upper wall.

Count is correct: father, mother holding baby girl, five boys and three girls total (10 people); Yitzhak seated with bandaged foot on stool; plain wall upper right. Eldest son not clearly older than the others and angle is eye level; minor.
Doctor on right facing seated parents across desk, grey window light, wall space above doctor.
Muddy road out of town at grey dawn, two tiny figures, open sky upper right.
Tall exam room, doctor in white coat examining boy's foot, bearded father pointing, high plain wall for balloons. Camera near eye level rather than low; acceptable.
High-angle medium shot, mother with swaddled baby and smiling midwife in stove glow, blurred neighbours in snow through frosted window; calm upper-right wall. Matches plan.
